mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pin (pin_id, title, description, image_url, link_url, created_at) VALUES (pin_seq.NEXTVAL, #{title}, #{description}, #{imageUrl}, #{linkUrl}, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE pin SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, link_url = #{linkUrl}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE pin_id = #{pinId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT pin_id, user_id, title, description, image_url, link_url, created_at, updated_at FROM pin WHERE pin_id = #{pinId}
